svg.text: SATELLITE → AI → HERDER'S PHONE · VOICE · USSD · SMS
A herder loses KES 200,000 of livestock
Drought is the single largest cause of household poverty in northern
Kenya. Satellites see the vegetation stress two to three weeks before a
herder does — but the signal never reaches the phone.
A voice-first intelligence layer that lives on a 2G phone.
Every five days, the satellite reads every patch of the ward. When the pasture starts to fail, the platform calls the herder
in Swahili, English, or Borana to ask what she sees on the ground.
Three small services. One secure database. That's the whole platform.
EVERY 5 DAYS · satellite reads the ward → AI writes the brief → we call her → she decides
From dial-tone to ground-truth report in five steps.
Africa's Talking production key + DID pool
